items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: his brother-in-law Chip on the guitar, Eddie Thomas on the drum.

ctx.x: Well anyhow, that was the first, not the first, but that was the last thing. We worked out there, and that's the last time I worked with Buddy. And as the calendar clicks off as it does, Harry, I put it there, we organized, not we, he did, and he got me to work on it with him. We worked here in the Bay, and Claremont Harbour, and the Kill, and the Ditto, and so forth and on. And we got along and we were fine. Well that band consists of Harry Fanky, who, as he told you, he had picked up his trumpet hand. It was…
